conventions.curvature_commutator: [nabla_alpha,nabla_beta] v^mu = +R^mu_(nu alpha beta) v^nu; matches RiemannTensor4::from_metric_derivatives
conventions.geodesic_deviation: D xi/dlambda = ell; D ell/dlambda = +T xi
conventions.optical_tidal_operator: T^mu_nu = R^mu_(alpha nu beta) k^alpha k^beta, with the source code's positive commutator convention
conventions.endpoint_comparison: Only compare after explicit event, chart, tetrad, affine normalization and source-surface matching.
conventions.sachs_screen_sign_policy: Derive the projected 2x2 screen-tidal sign from the declared curvature convention and explicit screen projection. The existing Rust Sachs/Jacobi convention D''=-T_AB D must be mapped and tested; do not copy the full four-dimensional T sign by name.
conventions.wronskian_basis_policy: Use constant Omega only in a declared parallel-transported orthonormal frame; in a general coordinate basis use the metric-weighted bilinear form and endpoint basis transformations.

operator.canonical_comparison: Transform the canonical (delta x, delta p) fundamental matrix into covariant (xi,ell) at both endpoints, including metric and metric-derivative terms. Direct elementwise 8x8 comparison is forbidden.
operator.screen_reduction: Seed with observer angular variations, project into the parallel Sachs screen, and apply the fixed-source-event correction. Emit fixed-affine and fixed-source maps separately.
